purpose: Perform a bounded read-only audit establishing that the qualified v2.0.1 subject is exactly the accepted two-commit remediation delta above the immutable v2.0.0 release container, without architecture, runtime-feature, Packages, or ProjectSettings scope expansion.

requirements.statement: Annotated v2.0.0 must still peel to the frozen release Container B.
The qualified subject must contain exactly the two accepted remediation commits above v2.0.0 Container B.
The v2.0.0 Container B to qualified-subject changed-path set must equal the six approved remediation paths.
No runtime feature code or architecture-authority path may change.
No Packages or ProjectSettings path may change.
The qualified Bootstrap Source Identity must equal the reviewed RMD-T01 Source Identity.
The completed RMD-001, RMD-T01, and fresh-consumer RV1-RV4 acceptance evidence must remain accepted.
The producer repository and origin/specops-v2 must remain synchronized at the qualified subject with a clean worktree.
